name: Studio Stickman
description: Stick figure animation from text: scenes are YAML (figures, poses and actions on a timeline, props, camera, words, sound effects) rendered to MP4/GIF/WebM; contact sheets (close-ups, every frame, onion skin) and a text view of any moment to check it; sprite sheets for games. Fights with blocks and knock-outs, dialogues, dances on the beat of a studio-daw song; walking feet stay planted. Extensible with Python plugins (poses, actions, fx, props, backdrops, sounds, particles).

commands.description: create a starter scene from a template
validate scenes fast: names, parameters, timing; plays them through to catch plugin and drawing errors

commands.usage: studio-stickman sheet <scene> [--at T,T,…] [--from T] [--to T] [--count N] [--step S] [--cols N] [--width PX] [--focus NAME] [--onion N] [--markers] [--out FILE] [--name N]
commands.description: contact sheet PNG of the key moments (or --at / --step frames) — read it before rendering
the state at a time as text: pose, position, action, camera view, events, gaps between figures
who does what when, with the moment each strike lands

commands.usage: studio-stickman render <scene> [--preview] [--draft] [--from T] [--to T] [--fps N] [--scale F] [--res 360p|480p|540p|720p|1080p|1440p|2160p|4k] [--gif] [--webm] [--frames] [--no-audio] [--jobs N] [--progress auto|text|json|none] [--out DIR] [--name N]
commands.description: render the video: MP4 with sound (+ GIF, WebM, PNG frames, contact sheet); --draft for a quick look

commands.usage: studio-stickman sprite <scene> --figure NAME [--from T] [--to T] [--frames N] [--size PX] [--cols N] [--out DIR] [--name N]
commands.description: transparent sprite sheet + atlas JSON of one figure, for games
what scenes can use: poses, actions, fx, props, backdrops, sounds, particles, hats, expressions, eases, events
the pose catalogue (--preview: a picture of every pose with its name)
write a starter plugin that extends the tool (plugins/stickman/<name>.py)

commands.usage: studio-stickman watch <scene> [--sheet] [--at T,T,…] [--focus NAME] [--strict] [--interval S] [--max-runs N] [--timeout S]
commands.description: check (and sheet) a scene again every time it or a plugin is saved
JSON Schema of the scene format, made from the registries (editors, self-checks)
check the setup: Python, ffmpeg and its encoders, parallel rendering, project folder, plugins, fonts, a test render
the format reference (README), or one part of it: docs actions
